Question 3
?

Find the first three non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of the function f(x)=xcos⁡x.

a
xcos⁡x=x−x32+x524+⋯
b
xcos⁡x=x−x32+x55+⋯
c
xcos⁡x=x+x26+x4120+⋯
d
xcos⁡x=x+x32+x524+⋯
e
xcos⁡x=x−x26+x4120+⋯
